LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LadyGaveM:
Yippee!
The lady at the reception counter gave me a case for {POKEBLOCK}S!
LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MakePokeb:
Make {POKEBLOCK}S and put them in there.
When you make a {POKEBLOCK}, everyone has to put in a different BERRY.
LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_YourPokem:
Congratulations!
I did a painting of your POKéMON to commemorate its victory…
Well, your POKéMON's appeals were so fantastic, it spurred me into painting better than I usually do. Look, see?
LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ShouldITa:
What do you think? I'm confident in what I've done, but do you like it?
A work of this caliber, it wouldn't look out of place in an art museum.
Huh? An art museum really is looking for paintings?
Do you think I should take this there?
LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_IllTakePa:
What, really? Then, sure, I will take this painting there right now.
I'll give it a proper title, too.
I hope they'll like it and consider exhibiting this.
Please check if they did accept this. Thank you!
LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeMemen:
Oh, that's right!
As a memento of me painting your POKéMON, please take this.
LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeHomeB:
Oh… Then, I guess I'll just take this home with me…
But, you know, I would like to take this to the art museum… Okay?
LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_FineThats:
Oh, fine, that's the way it is. I will hang this in my own house.
I'll just have to try harder next time. Well, be seeing you.
LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MasterRan:
Hoo, boy… Master Rank CONTESTS, here I come.
The world will know that my dearest POKéMON is the cutest being in all existence. The time has come! Uheheheh.
LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WholeVari:
You can see a whole variety of POKéMON here.
That's why I make this place a regular part of my daily stroll.
LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ContestFe:
Wow, coming out to a CONTEST is a feast for these eyes!
Would you look at all the POKéMON that just scream to be painted?
LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ToughCont:
The TOUGHNESS CONTEST is like extreme, man!
Those muscular appeals… Cascading sweat… I swoon!
LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LavishedC:
Day in and day out, I lavished my care on this POKéMON.
Its condition is peaking. Today, victory is mine!
LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MadePokeb:
I made {POKEBLOCK}S with Mom, Dad, and Big Sister. They turned out great!
I bet you can make smoother, better {POKEBLOCK}S if you have more people.
